module_summary: Converts an always-accepted valid input into a valid/ready stream via a depth-2 FIFO with fall-through that overwrites the newest entry when full and stalled.

anchors.name: mem_q
anchors.why: Two-entry data buffer written at write pointer, overwritten when full

anchors.name: pending_tx_counter_q
anchors.why: Occupancy count steering fall-through, overwrite, valid and busy

anchors.name: write_ptr_q
anchors.why: Write slot pointer, held on overwrite

anchors.name: read_ptr_q
anchors.why: Read slot pointer selecting buffered output, advanced on handshake

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Input valid; writes or falls through, no backpressure

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Input data stored or bypassed to output

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Output valid when FIFO non-empty or input valid

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Downstream ready; pops FIFO and decides overwrite

anchors.name: data_o
anchors.why: Output data from buffer or fall-through input

groups.name: Lossy FIFO buffer
groups.description: Depth-2 buffer with overwrite of last element

groups.name: Transaction counter
groups.description: Tracks pending items for valid, fall-through and busy
